subject: Cannot log in after password reset
body:
Hi team,

Since yesterday I cannot log in. I reset my password, got the email, set a new one, and the login page still says 'invalid credentials'. Tried Chrome and Firefox. My account is priya@acme-corp.com.

This is blocking my whole team of 12 people.

Priya

subject: Export to CSV fails with 500 error
body:
When I click Export > CSV on the Reports page I get a 500 error. Happens every time for reports with more than ~2000 rows. Smaller reports export fine.

Dan

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body:
Love the product. It would be great if you could add a dark mode - I use it late at night and the white background is harsh.

Thanks!

subject: How do I add a team member?
body: Hello, quick question - how do I invite another person to my workspace? I can't find the button. Is it possible on the free plan?

subject: Rank #1 on Google - limited offer!
body: We offer premium SEO services and guest post placements. Buy now and get 50% off. Click here to claim. Unsubscribe at any time.

subject: Re: Login broken after resetting password
body: Same problem as my colleague Priya reported - after a password reset I cannot log in, always 'invalid credentials'. Please fix ASAP.

subject: Charged twice for September subscription
body: My card was charged twice on Sep 1 for the Pro plan ($49 x 2). Invoice numbers INV-1042 and INV-1043. Please refund one of them and check whether this affects other customers.

subject: Dashboard is very slow to load
body: The main dashboard takes 20-30 seconds to load since last week's update. It used to be instant. We have about 15k records. Not blocking but annoying.

subject: Please add webhook support for the API
body: We'd like to receive a webhook when a record is updated instead of polling the API every minute. Support for a simple POST callback with a shared secret would be enough. Would be nice to have this by Q4.

subject: Wrong date shown on iPhone
body: In the iOS app the 'last updated' date is shown one day earlier than on the website. Timezone is Europe/Lisbon. Cosmetic, but confusing.
